"''This is shuttle 81572 requesting access to Citadel Prison.|K2-B4 and OOM-10|}} '''Shuttle 81572''' was a captured [[Sheathipede-class Type B shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class Type B shuttle]] that was used by the [[Galactic Republic]] in [[20 BBY]] to [[Battle of Lola Sayu|infiltrate]] the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist]]-controlled [[Citadel]] prison on [[Lola Sayu]]. Piloted by a [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron|squad]] of reprogrammed [[battle droid]]s under the command of the [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]], the ship, carrying a Republic strike team frozen in [[carbonite]] to evade lifeform scanners, gained access onto the planet by claiming that it carried supplies and frozen rations. Landing in a hidden canyon, R2-D2 and his droid crew waited by the ship as the strike team was unfrozen and headed off for the prison to rescue [[Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell]] and his officers. R2-D2 and his crew later took the shuttle to the Citadel's landing pad in an attempt at an evacuation. However, the shuttle was destroyed by a [[BX-series droid commando|commando droid]] manning a [[turbolaser]] turret during a battle on the landing pad, apparently [[Death|killing]] [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Echo]], who had been attempting to reclaim the ship. As a result, the remaining Republic soldiers and [[Jedi]] were forced to request assistance, leading [[Jedi General]] [[Plo Koon]] to bring a large fleet to evacuate them from the [[planet]]. Unbeknownst to the Republic, Echo had not actually perished in the shuttle's explosion. Severely injured, he was salvaged by the Separatists and wound up in the hands of the [[Techno Union]], who turned him into a [[cyborg]] in order to extract information from his [[brain]]. Kept in a [[stasis chamber]], Echo constantly relived the shuttle explosion at the Citadel for some time until [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|rescued]] by [[General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]], [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], and [[Clone Force 99]]. ==Description== {{Quote|We need to launch a full forward assault and take that vessel.''"
"''We may have a bigger problem, those turrets. If we don't take them out, they will use them to destroy the shuttle and prevent our escape.''"
"''Which is precisely why we should get aboard that shuttle and use the weapons systems to decimate those droids.|Wilhuff Tarkin and Obi-Wan Kenobi|}} Shuttle 81572 was a [[Sheathipede-class Type B shuttle|''Sheathipede''-class Type B shuttle]]. Like all [[shuttle]]s of that model, it was manufactured by [[Haor Chall Engineering Corporation]], was equipped with a [[hyperdrive]], and was armed with three [[laser cannon]]s. It was intended as a cargo shuttle. ==History== {{Quote|We have captured the shuttle that inflitrated our defenses.''"
"''Good. Guard the shuttle, and we'll lure the Jedi into a trap.|K2-B4 and Osi Sobeck|}} [[File:CarboniteClones-TC.png|thumb|left|300px|The strike team was frozen in carbonite to sneak pass the Separatist blockade.]] Shuttle 81572 was originally owned and used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. However, during the [[Clone Wars]] between the Confederacy and the [[Galactic Republic]], the shuttle was captured by the Republic. In [[20 BBY]], the shuttle was brought to the [[Imperial Palace|Jedi Temple]] [[hangar]]s on [[Coruscant]], as it was to be used in an [[Battle of Lola Sayu|infiltration]] of the Separatist-controlled [[Citadel]] [[prison]] on [[Lola Sayu]] to rescue captured [[Jedi Master]] [[Even Piell]], who had retrieved the coordinates of the secret [[Nexus Route]] [[Hyperspace route|hyperlane]]. The shuttle was placed under the command of [[astromech droid]] [[R2-D2]], who had a [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron|squadron]] of reprogrammed [[battle droid]]s which would fly the [[starship]]. In order to infiltrate the Citadel, [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] had the team, himself included, undergo [[carbon-freezing]] to beat the prison's lifeform scanners. Once the team had been frozen, they were loaded onboard the shuttle, which its [[droid]] crew [[pilot]]ed away from Coruscant, with [[Jedi]] Master [[Plo Koon]] seeing the ship off. When the shuttle arrived at Lola Sayu, it was hailed by [[T-series military strategic analysis and tactics droid|T-series tactical droid]] [[K2-B4]] at Citadel command, who ordered the ship to identify itself and its cargo. R2-D2 had his droid crew respond, claiming they carried supplies and frozen rations. They were ordered to not deviate from their course while they were scanned for lifeforms. Passing the scan, Shuttle 81572 was granted clearance to land at the Citadel. R2-D2 and the battle droids flew the shuttle down to the planet, before diverting their course and landing in a hidden canyon. There, they unfroze the members of the strike team, and waited there on Skywalker's orders for the summons to evac the strike team. After the strike team had rescued [[General]] Piell and his [[officer]]s, they split into two groups to evade the prison's security. Skywalker contacted R2-D2 and ordered the droid to bring the shuttle to the Citadel's landing platform to pick up [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]]'s group, before heading to the pipeline exit to collect Skywalker's team. However, the plan was compromised, as Kenobi's group was captured by prison [[warden]] [[Osi Sobeck]] and his [[BX-series droid commando]]s. Sobeck had also noticed the shuttle's absence, finding it suspicious. When the shuttle landed at the prison, R2-D2's battle droids improvised a ploy by pretending the astromech was their prisoner to get inside the Citadel, which R2 later expressed his displeasure about as it had left the shuttle unguarded. However, the droid team was able to rescue Kenobi and his team. They attempted to reclaim the shuttle, with the reprogrammed droids claiming the "prisoners" were being transferred to a nonexistent [[Point Tarron]] outpost, but this began a firefight. [[File:IGotDis-Counterattack.png|thumb|right|270px|Shuttle 81572 explodes and seemingly kills ARC trooper Echo]] Skywalker's group, ambushed at the pipeline exit, was forced to flee the area, and headed for the Citadel landing platform. There, they joined the firefight. During the skirmish, a battle droid manning one of the prison's [[turbolaser]] turrets was destroyed, and a commando droid knocked off of a [[Single Trooper Aerial Platform|STAP]] by the Jedi went to man the platform. Skywalker and Piell, riding a hijacked STAP, attempted to destroy the droid, but were shot down. [[Advanced Recon Commando|ARC trooper]] [[Echo]], noticing that the shuttle was in danger of being destroyed by the commando droid, made a run for the ship, grabbing a dropped energy shield and making it to the [[Entry ramp|boarding ramp]]. However, moments later, the shuttle was destroyed by turret fire, to the horror of Echo's comrade [[Fives]]. With Echo seemingly [[Death|killed]] in the explosion, the team was forced to retreat from the landing platform. The Jedi and Republic subsequently sent an entire [[fleet]] of four [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], commanded by Master Plo, fellow Jedi Generals [[Adi Gallia]], [[Saesee Tiin]], and [[Kit Fisto]], as well as [[Admiral]] [[Barton Coburn]], to rescue the strike team. The rescue was a success, although Piell perished in the fighting and passed his half of the Nexus Route coordinates on to [[Padawan]] [[Ahsoka Tano]], who was not even supposed to be a member of the strike team in the first place.{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} However, the Republic remained unaware that Echo had not actually died in the shuttle's explosion. Severely injured, he was salvaged by the Separatists and sold to the [[Techno Union]], who turned him into a [[cyborg]] in order to extract information from his [[brain]].{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} Among the extracted information was a [[Rex's battle strategy algorithm|battle strategy algorithm]] developed by [[Clone Captain]] [[Rex]], and its use against the Republic during the [[Battle of Anaxes]] led Rex to suspect that Echo was still alive.{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}} Kept in a [[stasis chamber]] in [[Purkoll]] on [[Skako Minor]], Echo constantly relived the shuttle explosion until he was [[Mission to Skako Minor (Clone Wars)|rescued]] by Skywalker, Rex and [[Clone Force 99]]. ==Commanders and crew== {{Quote|R2, are you and your battle droids ready to go?''"
[R2-D2 beeps]
"''All right, get the ship fired up. We'll meet you at the pipeline exit after you've picked up Obi-Wan, assuming he's still on schedule.''|Anakin Skywalker and R2-D2|}} On the mission to the Citadel, shuttle 81572 was placed under the command of Anakin Skywalker's astromech droid R2-D2. A [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron|trio of reprogrammed battle droids]] under his command, led by [[OOM-10]], flew the ship to Lola Sayu so it could infiltrate the Separatist lines. ==Behind the scenes== Shuttle 81572 first appeared in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' [[The Clone Wars: Season Three|third season]] episode "[[The Citadel (episode)|The Citadel]]." ==Appearances== *{{TCW|The Citadel (episode)}} {{1st}} *{{TCW|Counterattack}} *{{TCW|Citadel Rescue}} {{Flash}} *{{TCW|A Distant Echo}} {{Imo}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|35|Weapons & Uniforms}} {{Imo}} *''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia of Starfighters and Other Vehicles]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|R2-D2}} {{Imo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ja=シャトル81572 |pl=Transportowiec 81572 }} [[Category:Captured starships]] [[Category:Sheathipede-class Type B shuttles]] [[Category:Starships of the Confederacy of Independent Systems]]
